manifest.description.message: See what's playing on Spotify, control playback, like / unlike, queue, and manage playlists from Kage.

result.now.label.description: Result label for the now-playing row

result.now.description.description: Result description for the now-playing row

result.help.label.description: Result label for the help row

result.help.description.message: Try: sp play <song>, sp queue <song>, sp like, sp next, sp vol 50, sp device, sp playlist <name>

help.commands_markdown.message:
**Spotify commands** (trigger: `{trigger}`)

- `{trigger}` — show what's now playing
- `{trigger} play <song>` — play the first match (bare `{trigger} play` resumes)
- `{trigger} pause` — pause playback
- `{trigger} queue <song>` — add the first match to the queue
- `{trigger} next` / `{trigger} prev` — skip forward / back
- `{trigger} like` / `{trigger} unlike` — like or unlike the current track
- `{trigger} vol <0-100>` — set volume on the active device
- `{trigger} device` — pick a Spotify Connect device (`{trigger} device <name>` targets one directly)
- `{trigger} playlist <name>` — play a playlist whose name matches
- `{trigger} connect` / `{trigger} sign-out` — sign in to Spotify / disconnect
help.commands_markdown.description: Markdown cheat-sheet printed to chat when the Commands row is run. {trigger} is the configured trigger word.

widget.disconnected.reconnect.description: Button on the disconnected now-playing bar that restarts sign-in

settings.description.message: See what's playing, queue songs, like the current track, skip — all from the Kage launcher or a chat command. Sign in with your own Spotify account; your password never leaves your browser.

settings.show_now_playing_bar.label.message: Show now-playing bar in the floating window

settings.refresh_seconds.description.message: How often Kage checks Spotify for what's playing. Lower numbers update the bar faster but ask Spotify more often. Default is 15 seconds.

settings.trigger.description.message: What you type to invoke Spotify shortcuts in the floating window. For example, "sp like" or "sp play lofi beats".

settings.commands.label.description: Label for the launcher-commands reference panel in settings

settings.commands.html.message:
{trigger} — now playing
{trigger} play <song> — play a track (bare {trigger} play resumes)
{trigger} pause — pause
{trigger} queue <song> — queue a track
{trigger} next / {trigger} prev — skip
{trigger} like / {trigger} unlike — like / unlike current track
{trigger} vol <0-100> — set volume
{trigger} device — pick a playback device
{trigger} playlist <name> — play a matching playlist
{trigger} connect / {trigger} sign-out — sign in / disconnect
settings.commands.html.description: HTML body listing supported launcher commands (HTML allowed). {trigger} is the configured trigger word.

settings.connection.revoked.message: Session expired. Spotify no longer accepts the saved sign-in — click Reconnect to sign in again.
settings.connection.revoked.description: Settings: stored credentials exist but Spotify has revoked them (detected by the now-playing widget's polls)

settings.check_connection.label.description: Settings: button that validates the stored Spotify session against the API

settings.disconnect.confirm.message: Sign out of Spotify? Kage also forgets your Client ID, so you'll go through setup again to reconnect.
settings.disconnect.confirm.description: Confirmation prompt before signing out. Signing out also deletes the saved Client ID, so the settings page returns to the guided setup.

settings.app.client_id_html.message: Connected through your Spotify app with Client ID {client_id}.
settings.app.client_id_html.description: Regular settings, 'Spotify app' section. {client_id} is the user's Client ID. Keep the <code> tags.

settings.rerun_setup.label.description: Button that restarts the guided setup, e.g. to switch to a different Spotify app

settings.rerun_setup.description.message: Go through the setup steps again — for example, to switch to a different Spotify app.
settings.rerun_setup.description.description: Help text above the 'Run setup again' button

settings.connect.error.timeout.message: ⚠️ Spotify didn't send you back to Kage within 5 minutes. If your browser showed an INVALID_CLIENT error, click Run setup again to check your app's Client ID and Redirect URI.
settings.connect.error.timeout.description: Reconnect (regular settings) gave up waiting for the browser. INVALID_CLIENT is Spotify's literal error text and must stay in English; 'Run setup again' is a button label.

settings.connect.error.app.message: ❌ Spotify rejected your app's settings. Click Run setup again to check the Client ID and Redirect URI.
settings.connect.error.app.description: Reconnect (regular settings) failed because Spotify doesn't accept the Client ID or Redirect URI. 'Run setup again' is a button label.

settings.validate.trigger_required.description: Validation error when trigger is empty

settings.validate.trigger_format.message: Trigger must be letters, digits, or hyphens.
settings.validate.trigger_format.description: Validation error for invalid trigger characters

action.connect.success.message: ✅ Connected. Now-playing bar will appear when something is playing.

action.check_connection.ok.message: ✅ Connected. Your Spotify session is valid.

action.check_connection.ok_named.message: ✅ Connected as {name}. Your Spotify session is valid.
action.check_connection.ok_named.description: Status when the live connection check succeeds and a display name is known

action.check_connection.no_client_id.message: ⚠️ No Client ID saved yet, so setup needs to run first.
action.check_connection.no_client_id.description: Status when a settings action needs a Client ID but none is saved (for example after signing out from the launcher). The page then switches to the guided setup.

action.check_connection.not_signed_in.message: ⚠️ Not signed in. Click Connect to sign in to Spotify.

action.check_connection.revoked.message: ❌ Your Spotify session has expired or was revoked. Click Connect to sign in again.

action.check_connection.network.message: ⚠️ Couldn't reach Spotify. Check your connection and try again — your session may still be fine.

keyword.spotify.label.description: Keyword hint label for the Spotify trigger

keyword.spotify.description.description: Keyword hint description for the Spotify trigger

setup.description.message: Spotify needs a one-time setup before this extension can do anything: you register a free Spotify app, then sign in. It takes about three minutes, and your progress is saved if you close this window.
setup.description.description: Intro shown above the guided setup steps

setup.description_rerun.message: You're running setup again. Your current connection keeps working until you connect again — or click Cancel setup to leave everything as it was.
setup.description_rerun.description: Intro shown above the guided setup when the user chose 'Run setup again' while connected. 'Cancel setup' is a button label.

setup.step_label.description: Heading of a setup step, e.g. 'Step 2 of 4: Create a Spotify app'. {title} is one of the setup.*.title strings.

setup.next.label.description: Button that moves to the next setup step

setup.back.label.description: Button that returns to the previous setup step

setup.cancel.label.description: Button that leaves a re-run of the setup and returns to the regular settings, changing nothing

setup.open_dashboard_again.label.description: Secondary button that reopens the Spotify Developer Dashboard in the browser

setup.not_using_html.message: Not using Spotify? You can switch this extension off with the button at the top of this page.
setup.not_using_html.description: Hint on the first setup step for users who don't want the extension

setup.dashboard.body_html.message:
Spotify only lets apps like Kage control your music through an app you register with them. It's free, you only do it once, and all you need is your Spotify login.

Click Open Spotify Dashboard. Log in in your browser, and accept the developer terms if Spotify asks. Then come back here for the next step.
setup.dashboard.body_html.description: Body of setup step 1. 'Open Spotify Dashboard' is the button label below it. Keep the HTML tags.

setup.dashboard.premium_html.message: Good to know: Spotify only allows playback control (play, pause, skip) for Premium accounts. Seeing what's playing works with any account.
setup.dashboard.premium_html.description: Note on setup step 1 about Spotify's Premium requirement for playback control

setup.dashboard.open.label.description: Primary button on setup step 1; opens developer.spotify.com/dashboard in the system browser

setup.dashboard.opened.description: Status after the Spotify Developer Dashboard was opened in the browser

setup.dashboard.open_failed.message: ⚠️ Couldn't open your browser. Go to {url} yourself, then click Next.
setup.dashboard.open_failed.description: Status when opening the dashboard failed. {url} is the dashboard address; 'Next' is a button label.

setup.create_app.body_html.message:
In the dashboard, click Create app and fill in the form:

  1. App name and App description: anything you like, for example “Kage”.
  2. Redirect URIs: paste the address below and click Add.
  3. Under Which API/SDKs are you planning to use?, tick Web API.
  4. Accept Spotify's terms and click Save.

Already have an app? Add the address below to its Redirect URIs (in its Settings), save, and click Next.
setup.create_app.body_html.description: Body of setup step 2. Bold names in the list (Create app, App name, App description, Redirect URIs, Add, Which API/SDKs are you planning to use?, Web API, Save, Settings) are labels on Spotify's English-only dashboard: keep them in English. 'Next' is a Kage button label. Keep the HTML tags.

setup.create_app.redirect_label.description: Label above the address the user must register in their Spotify app

setup.create_app.redirect_hint_html.message: Copy it exactly: http (not https), 127.0.0.1 (not localhost), ending in /spotify/callback. The port number doesn't have to match anything — Kage picks a free one each time you connect, and Spotify allows that for 127.0.0.1.
setup.create_app.redirect_hint_html.description: Hint below the Redirect URI. Keep the <code> parts exactly as they are.

setup.client_id.body_html.message:
Spotify now shows your app. Open its Settings and copy the Client ID — a 32-character code of letters and numbers — then paste it below.

You don't need the Client secret, so leave it hidden.
setup.client_id.body_html.description: Body of setup step 3. Settings, Client ID and Client secret are labels on Spotify's English-only dashboard: keep them in English. Keep the HTML tags.

setup.client_id.label.description: Label of the Client ID field (Spotify's term; keep in English if your language commonly does)

setup.client_id.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the empty Client ID field

setup.client_id.description.message: Saved on this computer only, and sent to nobody but Spotify.
setup.client_id.description.description: Help text under the Client ID field

setup.client_id.description_connected.message: Saved on this computer only. Saving a different Client ID signs you out of your current Spotify connection.
setup.client_id.description_connected.description: Help text under the Client ID field when setup is re-run while connected

setup.client_id.save.label.description: Primary button on setup step 3: checks and saves the Client ID

setup.client_id.error.empty.message: ⚠️ Paste your Client ID first. It's on your app's Settings page in the Spotify dashboard.
setup.client_id.error.empty.description: Validation error: the Client ID field is empty

setup.client_id.error.url.message: ⚠️ That's a web address, not a Client ID. On your app's Settings page, copy the code shown under Client ID.
setup.client_id.error.url.description: Validation error: the user pasted a URL instead of the Client ID

setup.client_id.error.format.message: ⚠️ That doesn't look like a Client ID. It's a 32-character code of letters and numbers — check you copied all of it, with no spaces.
setup.client_id.error.format.description: Validation error: the pasted text has the wrong shape for a Spotify Client ID

setup.client_id.error.unknown_client.message: ❌ Spotify doesn't recognise this Client ID. Copy the Client ID (not the Client secret) from your app's Settings page and try again.
setup.client_id.error.unknown_client.description: Error: Spotify confirmed that no app has this Client ID (typo, or the Client secret was pasted)

setup.connect.body_html.message: Click Connect to Spotify. Your browser opens Spotify's permission page: log in if asked, then click Agree. Come back here afterwards — Kage finishes on its own.
setup.connect.body_html.description: Body of setup step 4. 'Connect to Spotify' is the button below; 'Agree' is the button on Spotify's page. Keep the HTML tags.

setup.connect.notice_revoked_html.message: Your Spotify sign-in expired or was revoked. Your app details are still saved — just connect again.
setup.connect.notice_revoked_html.description: Shown on setup step 4 when the user was sent back there because Spotify no longer accepts the saved sign-in

setup.connect.button.description: Primary button on setup step 4: starts the browser sign-in

setup.connect.trouble_label.message: If your browser shows an error
setup.connect.trouble_label.description: Label of the troubleshooting list on setup step 4

setup.connect.trouble_html.message:
• INVALID_CLIENT: Invalid redirect URI — your app doesn't list Kage's Redirect URI. Click Back twice, add {uri} to your app in Spotify, and click Save there.
  • INVALID_CLIENT: Invalid client — Spotify doesn't know this Client ID. Click Back and paste it again.
setup.connect.trouble_html.description: Troubleshooting list on setup step 4. The bold INVALID_CLIENT lines are Spotify's literal English error texts: keep them unchanged. 'Back' is a button label. {uri} is the Redirect URI. Keep the HTML tags.

setup.connect.error.timeout.message: ⚠️ Spotify didn't send you back to Kage within 5 minutes. If your browser showed “Invalid redirect URI”, click Back twice and fix the Redirect URI in your Spotify app; if it showed “Invalid client”, click Back and check the Client ID. Otherwise, click Connect to Spotify to try again.
setup.connect.error.timeout.description: Setup step 4: the sign-in gave up waiting for the browser. 'Invalid redirect URI' and 'Invalid client' are Spotify's literal English error texts. 'Back' and 'Connect to Spotify' are button labels.

setup.connect.error.bad_client.message: ❌ Spotify doesn't recognise this Client ID. Click Back and paste the Client ID from your app's Settings page (not the Client secret).
setup.connect.error.bad_client.description: Setup step 4: Spotify rejected the Client ID. 'Back' is a button label.

setup.connect.error.redirect.message: ❌ Spotify rejected the Redirect URI. Click Back twice, make sure your Spotify app lists {uri} exactly, click Save in Spotify, and try again.
setup.connect.error.redirect.description: Setup step 4: Spotify rejected the Redirect URI. {uri} is the address to register. 'Back' is a button label.

setup.done.title.description: Heading of the final setup screen

setup.done.connected_named_html.description: Final setup screen headline. {name} is the user's Spotify display name.

setup.done.connected_html.description: Final setup screen headline when the Spotify display name is unknown

setup.done.tips_html.message: Type {trigger} in Kage's floating window to see what's playing, or {trigger} play and a song name to play it. You can also just ask the assistant, for example “play some lofi beats”. The now-playing bar shows up in the floating window whenever music is playing.
setup.done.tips_html.description: Tips on the final setup screen. {trigger} is the user's trigger word (default 'sp'); keep the <code> parts unchanged.

setup.done.finish.label.description: Button on the final setup screen; shows the regular settings

signin.error.denied.message: ⚠️ Access wasn't allowed on Spotify's page, so Kage can't connect. Try again and click Agree.
signin.error.denied.description: Sign-in failed because the user clicked Cancel on Spotify's permission page. 'Agree' is the button on that page.

signin.error.state.message: ⚠️ That sign-in reply didn't match this request (it may be from an older attempt). Please try again.
signin.error.state.description: Sign-in failed: the browser redirect didn't belong to the current attempt

signin.error.network.message: ⚠️ Couldn't reach Spotify. Check your internet connection and try again.

signin.error.oauth.message: ⚠️ Spotify reported a problem ({error}). Please try again.
signin.error.oauth.description: Sign-in failed with an error from Spotify. {error} is Spotify's error code, in English.

signin.error.unknown.description: Sign-in failed for an unexpected reason. {message} is a technical detail, in English.
